locator: Statistisches Jahrbuch der Schweiz 1950, printed p. 23, resident population by age and sex.
definition: Usual residents of Switzerland enumerated on the census date. Five-year age bands with 80 and over combined.
uncertainty: The unknown-age row is empty in print. The published age and sex totals account for all usual residents.
